name: ReportCiStatusOutputJS
title: ReportCiStatusOutputJS - Scoped
summary: The ReportCiStatusOutputJS API provides methods that return specific object properties for the DiscoveryAPI reportCiIpAddressStatus method and then converts the information into a JSON string.
overview: This class runs is in the sn_discovery namespace.

members.name: getCiOperationStatus
members.summary: Returns the state of the scanned CI.
members.html:
This is a calculated field based on the last_state field in discovery_device_history table and the state field in the discovery_status table.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
string The three possible states returned by this method are:
  • Processing: Discovery is still processing the request.
  • Successful: A CI was created or updated.
  • NotSuccessful: A CI was not created or updated, and the Discovery status was Completed or Cancelled.
 
var ipResultObj = sn_discovery.DiscoveryAPI.reportCiIpAddressStatus(ipAddress, discoveryStatus);
gs.info("ipResultObj(CiOperationStatus): " + ipResultObj.getCiOperationStatus());

members.name: getCmdbCI
members.summary: Returns the value in the cmdb_ci field from the discovery_device_history table for the CI being scanned.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
string Sys_id of the CI created or updated. This value can be null in the case of intermediate results before a CI is created. 
var ipResultObj = sn_discovery.DiscoveryAPI.reportCiIpAddressStatus(ipAddress, discoveryStatus);
gs.info("ipResultObj(cmdb): " + ipResultObj.getCmdbCI());

members.name: getDiscoveryState
members.summary: Returns the value from the State field in the Discovery Status [discovery_status] table.
members.html:
The values returned by this method are used to calculate the value returned by the getCiOperationStatus() method

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
string The possible states returned by this method are:
  • Starting
  • Active
  • Complete
  • Cancelled
 
var ipResultObj = sn_discovery.DiscoveryAPI.reportCiIpAddressStatus(ipAddress, discoveryStatus);
gs.info("ipResultObj(discoveryState): " + ipResultObj.getDiscoveryState());

members.name: getIssuesLink
members.summary: Returns the value from the issues_link field in the discovery_device_history table for the CI being scanned.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
string The issues_link field from the discovery_device_history table.

This value may be null or an anchor tag defining a hyperlink to a page that provides the list of issues associated with the Discovery Status and CI (IP address).

members.name: toJson
members.html:
This method throws the IllegalArgumentException exception, Cannot serialize object, e when the method is unable to serialize the object. The e is the exception object, which provides the exception message and trace.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
string Serialized instance of the ReportCiStatusOutputJS object into a JSON string. 
var ipResultObj = sn_discovery.DiscoveryAPI.reportCiIpAddressStatus(ipAddress, discoveryStatus);
gs.info("ipResultObj(json): " + ipResultObj.toJson());
